data.one_liner: Cupertino-style bottom sheet that works from any context without a Scaffold, using a screenshot of the screen.
data.what_it_does: It captures the current screen as a RawImage and displays it as a bottom sheet, allowing swipe or button dismissal. The sheet can be opened from anywhere by using a global navigator key or a direct route push.
use_when: Need a Cupertino bottom sheet that can be shown from any part of the app without a Scaffold
Want a quick, minimal setup for a modal sheet
Need to avoid passing a BuildContext to open the sheet
avoid_when: Need complex custom animations that depend on the underlying widget tree
Require high-performance rendering for very large screens
Need to avoid the overhead of taking a screenshot
strengths: No Scaffold required, works from any context
Simple API, just wrap MaterialApp once
Supports custom app bars and swipe settings
weaknesses: Screenshot approach can be heavy on large screens
Limited to the visual snapshot of the current screen
Not suitable for highly dynamic content that changes after the sheet opens
data.setup_notes: Wrap your MaterialApp with CupertinoBottomSheetRepaintBoundary and optionally set cupertinoBottomSheetNavigatorKey.

alternatives.name: modal_bottom_sheet
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a more feature‑rich modal bottom sheet with built‑in animations and customization options.
